description: Check invoice XML with a fixed EN16931, XRechnung, Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3), RO or HR package. KSeF is XSD-only; Factur-X checks XML only. No authority or network acceptance check.

include_guides.description: Include guide URLs in validation results.

max_findings.description: Maximum combined errors and warnings returned (1–100). Validation scope is unchanged.

rulesDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for EN rules; default is the server date. National packages keep their own bundle.

standard.description: Explicit existing fixed rule package. Factur-X accepts extracted XML only; KSeF is FA(3) XSD only.

xml.description: Complete UTF-8 XML text, at most 10 MiB. DTDs and entities are blocked.

name: validate_e_invoice
title: Validate an e-invoice
